item.title: Like the US CIA... Government Nurtures Korea's Palantir (美 CIA처럼… 정부가 K팔란티어 키운다)
item.description:
Like the US CIA... Government Nurtures Korea's Palantir (美 CIA처럼… 정부가 K팔란티어 키운다)

The government is pushing to establish a "Korean-style In-Q-Tel," modeled after the US Central Intelligence Agency's (CIA) nonprofit venture capital firm In-Q-Tel, to directly invest in and support the growth of security-sector companies. This initiative aims to bolster national defense capabilities and defense industry competitiveness in modern warfare, where cutting-edge technologies such as drones, artificial intelligence (AI), and aerospace dictate the battlefield dynamics. (정부가 미 중앙정보국(CIA)의 비영리 벤처캐피털(VC) ‘인큐텔(In-Q-Tel)’처럼 안보 분야 기업에 직접 투자해 성장을 지원하는 ‘한국형 인큐텔’ 설립을 추진한다. 드론과 인공지능(AI), 우주항공 등 첨단 기술이 판도를 좌우하는 현대전(戰)에서 국방력과 방산 경쟁력을 강화하기 위해서다.)

On the 26th, the Ministry of SMEs and Startups announced a plan to foster innovative companies, centered on establishing a Korean-style In-Q-Tel, during a "Future New Security Innovation Enterprise Cultivation Strategy Meeting" held at the presidential office in Yongsan. In-Q-Tel, founded by the CIA in 1999, has invested in advanced technology companies with the goal of field deployment. A prime example of its investments is the military AI firm Palantir. (중소벤처기업부는 26일 청와대에서 열린 ‘미래 신(新)안보 혁신기업 육성 전략회의’에서 한국형 인큐텔 설립을 핵심으로 하는 혁신기업 육성 방안을 발표했다. CIA가 1999년 설립한 인큐텔은 실전 도입을 목표로 첨단 기술 기업에 투자해 왔다. 대표 투자 사례가 군사 AI 업체인 팔란티어다.)

President Lee Jae-myung, who chaired the meeting, stated, "We must create innovative companies that can compete confidently with the US-based Palantir, valued at 480 trillion won, or Germany's Helsing, worth 26 trillion won. We aim to foster five companies with a corporate value of over 1 trillion won and 50 companies with sales exceeding 100 billion won in the new security sector by 2030." (이날 회의를 주재한 이재명 대통령은 “기업 가치가 480조원에 이르는 미국 팔란티어나 26조원에 이르는 독일의 헬싱과 당당히 경쟁할 수 있는 혁신 기업을 우리도 만들어가야 되겠다”며 “2030년까지 신안보 분야에서 기업 가치 1조원 이상 기업 5개, 매출 1000억원 기업 50개 육성을 추진하겠다”고 말했다.)

The US CIA's In-Q-Tel invests approximately $100 million (about 154 billion won) annually. The Ministry of SMEs and Startups announced it will first contribute 25 billion won each with the Defense Acquisition Program Administration by next year to create a 50 billion won fund, and then establish a fund worth 1 trillion won by 2030. Considering the security industry's structure, which is difficult for startups to enter, the government said it will have the state swiftly purchase technologies and products from innovative companies in non-defense fields like aerospace, while in the defense sector, the military and companies will collaborate from the development stage to reduce the time required for introducing advanced weapons to within one year. (미 CIA의 인큐텔은 매년 1억달러(약 1540억원) 안팎을 투자한다. 중기부는 내년까지 우선 방위사업청과 250억원씩을 출자해 500억원을 조성하고, 2030년까지 1조원 규모 펀드도 조성하겠다고 했다. 정부는 신생 기업의 진입이 어려운 안보 산업 구조를 고려해 우주항공 같은 비국방 분야는 혁신 기업의 기술·제품을 국가가 신속히 구매하고, 국방 분야에서는 군과 기업이 개발 단계부터 협력해 첨단 무기 도입에 걸리는 시간을 1년 이내로 단축하겠다고 했다.)

item.title: Democratic Party: "Push to Dissolve the National Election Commission Through Constitutional Amendment" (민주당 “개헌 통해 선관위 해체 추진”)
item.description:
Democratic Party: "Push to Dissolve the National Election Commission Through Constitutional Amendment" (민주당 “개헌 통해 선관위 해체 추진”)

The Democratic Party of Korea stated on the 26th that it would change the name and committee composition structure of the National Election Commission (NEC) through a constitutional amendment, in response to the shortage of ballots for the June 3 local elections. Additionally, they decided to increase the number of standing election commissioners through legal amendments. (더불어민주당은 26일 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련, 개헌을 통해 중앙선거관리위원회의 명칭과 위원회 구성 방식을 바꾸겠다고 했다. 또 법 개정을 통해 상임 선관위원 숫자를 늘리기로 했다.)

Song Ki-heon, a lawmaker and head of the Democratic Party's "Task Force (TF) for Protecting People's Voting Rights and Reforming the NEC," said, "We will dissolve the NEC through a constitutional amendment," adding, "We will change its name and composition structure to ensure it becomes a constitutional body that broadly guarantees the people's right to vote." The NEC, being a constitutional institution, is currently not subject to audits by the Board of Audit and Inspection, and the party stated it would address this through a constitutional amendment as well. (민주당 ‘국민 참정권 수호 선관위 개혁 태스크포스(TF)’ 단장인 송기헌 의원은 이날 “헌법 개정을 통해 선관위를 해체하겠다”면서 “선관위가 국민의 참정권을 폭넓게 보장하는 헌법 기관이 되도록 명칭과 구성 방식을 변경하겠다”고 했다. 선관위는 헌법 기구라는 이유로 감사원의 직무 감찰을 받지 않고 있는데, 이 역시 개헌을 통해 고치겠다고 했다.)

Under the current constitution, the Central Election Commission is composed of three members appointed by the president, three elected by the National Assembly, and three nominated by the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court, with the chairperson elected by mutual vote among the members. Although the Democratic Party emphasized constitutional revision on this day, they did not disclose specific details of the reform. (현행 헌법에는 중앙선관위를 대통령 임명 3인, 국회 선출 3인, 대법원장 지명 3인의 위원으로 구성하고 위원장은 호선을 하게 돼 있다. 민주당은 이날 개헌을 강조했지만 구체적인 개편 내용은 밝히지 않았다.)

The TF stated that even before a constitutional amendment, they would make the chairperson of the NEC a full-time position through legal revision and increase the number of standing election commissioners from one to three. Lawmaker Song said they would continuously push for constitutional and legal amendments, but the opposition party maintains that comprehensive constitutional discussions, including the power structure, should take place. (TF는 개헌 전에라도 법률 개정을 통해 중앙선관위원장을 상임화하고, 상임 선관위원 수를 1명에서 3명으로 늘리겠다고 했다. 송 의원은 헌법과 법률 개정을 지속적으로 추진하겠다고 했지만, 야당은 권력 구조를 포함한 포괄적 개헌 논의를 해야 한다는 입장이다.)

The People Power Party responded: "What the people want is not a constitutional amendment, but a thorough investigation through a special counsel probe." The Democratic Party had previously insisted on a parliamentary investigation and police-prosecutor inquiries first, but on this day, TF deputy head Park Sang-hyuk stated, "It is a clear position that we will also pursue a special counsel investigation." (국민의힘은 “국민이 원하는 것은 개헌이 아니라 철저한 진상 규명 특검 수사”라고 했다. 민주당은 국정조사와 검경 수사가 먼저라는 입장이었는데, 이날 민주당 TF 부단장인 박상혁 의원은 “특검도 하겠다는 게 명확한 입장”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Han Sung-sook’s officetel sold to acquaintance at below-market price (한성숙 오피스텔 지인에 헐값 매각)
item.description:
Han Sung-sook’s officetel sold to acquaintance at below-market price (한성숙 오피스텔 지인에 헐값 매각)

On the second day of the parliamentary confirmation hearing for Prime Minister nominee Han Sung-sook held on the 26th, the ruling and opposition parties clashed over her real estate issues. While the People Power Party claimed she "falls short in capability and integrity," the Democratic Party of Korea plans to process the motion for her appointment at a plenary session of the National Assembly soon. <<> Lawmakers from the People Power Party raised suspicions of "circumstantial gifting," alleging that Han sold an officetel in Yeoksam-dong, Gangnam-gu, Seoul, to an acquaintance who runs a beauty salon at a low price. Han has sold three of her four properties in the past month. Among them, the officetel in Yeoksam-dong was purchased by Han for 2.0746 billion won in May of last year and sold for 1.5 billion won on the 23rd. <<> People Power Party lawmaker Kim Hee-jung questioned, "What kind of acquaintance is this to receive such preferential treatment, which even siblings would hesitate to give?" adding, "When I looked into the background of (the buyer, the) beauty salon owner, it turns out she was in charge of (former President Roh Moo-hyun's wife) Kwon Yang-sook." Han responded, "It wasn't selling (even when listed on the market), so I offered it at a low price, but dragging the first lady into this is hard to accept." Democratic Party lawmaker Lee So-young remarked, "If the opposition attacks someone for being a multi-homeowner, isn't it natural to lower the price and sell quickly?" People Power Party lawmaker Kang Seung-kyu said, "Han may have formed a network through that person (the beauty salon owner), and it's reasonable to suspect she sold the officetel cheaply as a favor in return." <<> When the opposition raised suspicions that Han had evaded gift taxes by leasing a commercial building to her family at a low price, she became tearful, saying, "There's a personal aspect to compensating my family for the time they’ve sacrificed because of me, and for my younger sibling taking full responsibility for our mother." <<> In response to a question from a People Power Party lawmaker about the high exchange rate, Han said, "The high exchange rate has made business very difficult in some respects, but on the other hand, it has a positive side for exports." When asked, "If the perceived inflation has risen sharply, who is responsible?" she replied, "Since the war in the Middle East, prices in all countries have risen significantly, and our government has managed oil prices very well." <<> People Power Party lawmaker Kang Seung-kyu, the secretary of the confirmation hearing special committee, stated, "She falls short in both capability and integrity, and we have no intention of consenting to her appointment." The Democratic Party plans to process the motion for the prime minister nominee's appointment at the National Assembly even if the opposition opposes it. The motion requires a majority of registered lawmakers present and a majority of votes in favor to pass, and the Democratic Party, holding 161 of the 300 seats, can handle it alone. (26일 열린 한성숙 국무총리 후보자 국회 인사청문회 둘째 날에도 여야는 한 후보자의 부동산 문제를 놓고 공방을 벌였다. 국민의힘은 “능력과 도덕성에서 자격 미달”이라고 했지만 더불어민주당은 조만간 국회 본회의에서 총리 임명 동의안을 처리할 예정이다.)

item.title: Former Blue House Secretary Lee Jin-guk Appointed as Audit Commissioner (이진국 전 靑비서관 감사원 감사위원에)
item.description:
Former Blue House Secretary Lee Jin-guk Appointed as Audit Commissioner (이진국 전 靑비서관 감사원 감사위원에)

President Lee Jae-myung on the 26th approved the appointment of former Blue House Secretary for Judicial System Lee Jin-guk as a commissioner of the Board of Audit and Inspection (BAI). The approval came on the same day that BAI Chair Kim Ho-cheol proposed the nomination, five months after Lee left the Blue House in January. As a result, appointees by President Lee now hold a majority in the BAI commissioners' meeting. (이재명 대통령이 26일 이진국 전 청와대 사법제도비서관의 감사위원 임명안을 재가했다. 김호철 감사원장이 임명 제청한 당일 재가한 것으로, 이 위원이 지난 1월 청와대를 나온 지 5개월 만이다. 이에 따라 감사원 감사위원회의에서 이 대통령이 임명한 인사들이 과반을 차지하게 됐다.)

A former professor at Ajou University Law School, Commissioner Lee served as a member of the Democratic Party's innovation committee and nomination management committee when President Lee was the party's leader. From July last year to January this year, immediately after the Lee Jae-myung administration's launch, he served as the Blue House secretary for judicial system. Lee reportedly aligned with hardliners within the Democratic Party regarding prosecutorial reform and expressed differences with moderates like former Senior Presidential Secretary for Civil Affairs Bong Wook, leading to his resignation. (아주대 법학전문대학원 교수 출신인 이 위원은 이 대통령이 더불어민주당 대표였던 시절 민주당 혁신위원, 공천관리위원 등을 역임했다. 이재명 정부 출범 직후인 지난해 7월부터 올해 1월까지는 청와대 사법제도비서관을 지냈다. 이 위원은 검찰 개편과 관련해서 더불어민주당 강경파와 뜻을 같이했고, ‘온건파’인 봉욱 전 민정수석 등과 이견이 있어 사의를 표명했던 것으로 알려졌다.)

BAI commissioners are vice-minister-level public officials appointed by the president upon the recommendation of the BAI chair, with a total of six members serving four-year terms each. Together with the BAI chair, they form the Commissioners' Meeting, which deliberates and decides on major audit plans and results by majority vote. The BAI Office can only initiate audits with approval from the Commissioners' Meeting, and audit reports must be approved by the same body before implementation or disclosure. (감사원 감사위원은 감사원장 제청으로 대통령이 임명하는 차관급 공직자로, 총 6인이고 임기는 각각 4년이다. 감사원장과 함께 감사위원회의를 구성해, 감사원의 주요 감사 계획과 감사 결과 등을 다수결로 심의·의결한다. 감사원 사무처는 감사위원회의 승인을 받아야 감사에 착수할 수 있고, 작성한 감사 보고서도 감사위원회의 의결을 거쳐야 시행·공개될 수 있다.)

The existing Commissioners' Meeting consisted of a 3-3 split: commissioners Kim Young-shin, Yoo Byung-ho, and Baek Jae-myung appointed by former President Yoon Suk Yeol, and Chair Kim Ho-cheol along with commissioners Choi Seung-pil and Im Seon-suk appointed by President Lee. Chair Kim is a former member of Lawyers for a Democratic Society (Minbyun). Commissioner Im served as a supreme council member when Lee was the Democratic Party leader and assisted First Lady Kim Hye-kyung as the "candidate's spouse office director" during the last presidential election. Now, Commissioner Lee, a former Blue House official from the Lee Jae-myung administration, has been added. (기존 감사위원회의는 윤석열 전 대통령이 임명한 김영신·유병호·백재명 위원과 이 대통령이 임명한 김호철 원장 및 최승필·임선숙 위원 등 3대3으로 이뤄져 있었다. 김 원장은 민변 출신이다. 임 위원은 이 대통령의 민주당 대표 시절 최고위원으로 활동했고, 지난 대선에서 ‘후보 배우자 실장’으로 이 대통령 부인 김혜경 여사를 보좌했었다. 여기에 이재명 정부의 청와대 출신인 이 위원이 더해진 것이다.)

Since President Lee took office, the BAI has dismantled the Special Investigation Bureau, which conducted audits targeting the Moon Jae-in administration, and abolished "policy audits." It has also taken measures such as re-investigating the Moon administration's distortion of the West Sea civil servant killing, the statistical manipulation case, and audits of the Yoon Suk Yeol administration's relocation of the presidential office and residence. (감사원은 이 대통령 취임 이후 문재인 정부를 겨냥한 감사를 했던 특별조사국을 없애고, ‘정책 감사’를 폐지했다. 문 정부의 서해 공무원 피살 왜곡 사건, 통계 조작 사건, 윤석열 정부의 대통령실·관저 이전 감사 등을 재조사하는 등의 조치도 해 왔다.)

item.title: North Fires Ballistic Missile on Korean War Anniversary… Military: Unaware or Covering Up? (北이 6·25 맞춰 탄도미사일 쐈는데… 軍, 몰랐나 숨겼나)
item.description:
North Fires Ballistic Missile on Korean War Anniversary… Military: Unaware or Covering Up? (北이 6·25 맞춰 탄도미사일 쐈는데… 軍, 몰랐나 숨겼나)

North Korea has revealed that it launched a ballistic missile on the 25th, the 76th anniversary of the outbreak of the Korean War, sparking controversy over why our military did not announce the launch that day. Since North Korea's ballistic missile launches violate UN Security Council resolutions against the North, our military has typically disclosed such launches to the media as soon as they are detected. In response to our inquiry about the reason for the lack of announcement, the Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS) only stated, "We are conducting a precise analysis of the detailed specifications of the detected projectiles." Critics point out that it would be problematic if the military failed to detect the ballistic missile launch, and also problematic if it withheld the announcement for other reasons. <<> On the 26th, the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA) reported that North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong-un observed "important weapons tests" organized by national defense science research institutes the previous day. The agency stated that tests included a 240mm 24-barrel multiple rocket launcher (MRL), extended-range shells for 155mm howitzers and field guns, and a special warhead test for a "tactical ballistic missile." It also released a photo showing the missile rising from its launcher. Shin Jong-woo, Secretary-General of the Korea Defense and Security Forum (KODEF), said, "Based on the launcher's form, it is analyzed to be a short-range ballistic missile (CRBM), the Hwasong-11Ra." <<> Typically, our military has promptly announced when it confirms North Korea has launched a ballistic missile. When North Korea launched a ballistic missile around 1:00 p.m. on May 26, the JCS informed the media at 2:15 p.m., stating, "Several short-range ballistic missiles were detected launched from the Jeongju area in North Pyongan Province toward the West Sea." This disclosed the detection about an hour after the launch. On April 19, the military disclosed North Korea's ballistic missile launch toward the East Sea approximately seven minutes after the event. <<> However, on the 25th, the JCS made no announcement regarding North Korean missiles. Only on the morning of the 26th, after North Korea revealed the ballistic missile launch through KCNA, did the JCS state, "Our military detected over a dozen launches, including MRLs, from North Korea's eastern region on June 25, and is conducting a precise analysis of the detailed specifications." This implies that while the MRL launches were confirmed, whether a ballistic missile was launched had not yet been verified. <<> Many experts describe this as "unusual." They note that it is not difficult for our military's detection assets to track North Korean ballistic missile trajectories and specifications, and it is uncommon for a clear assessment to remain undisclosed a day later. Secretary-General Shin said, "The trajectories of the MRLs and ballistic missiles may have been confused." This suggests that as North Korea conducted a 'mixed launch' of MRLs and ballistic missiles, the military may have been unable to make an immediate determination. <<> Yet, when North Korea mixed MRLs and ballistic missile launches on May 26, the military promptly detected the ballistic missile. Yang Wook, a research fellow at the Asan Institute for Policy Studies, stated, "The military's basic role is to quickly ascertain the exact specifications of North Korean projectiles. For some reason, this analytical capability appears to have been lacking." <<> Some voices suggest that the military may have detected the ballistic missile launch but refrained from disclosing it. Nam Sung-wook, a chair professor at Sookmyung Women's University, said, "I see almost no possibility that the military failed in detection and analysis. There may have been political pressure to avoid announcing that North Korea launched a ballistic missile on the same day President [Yoon] emphasized peace at the 6/25 commemoration ceremony." At the ceremony on the 25th, President Yoon did not mention North Korea, saying, "We will surely create a Korean Peninsula of peace where there is no need to fight." <<> There is also analysis that the U.S. restrictions on sharing North Korea-related intelligence, which began in early April following comments by Unification Minister Kim Young-ho regarding a "secret uranium enrichment facility," may have degraded our military's analysis capabilities. Secretary-General Shin mentioned, "North Korean missile specifications are analyzed by combining radar and satellite intelligence. Restrictions on U.S. satellite intelligence may have negatively impacted the military's analysis capability and speed." However, the JCS stated, "Intelligence exchanges between South Korea and the U.S. are proceeding closely." (북한이 6·25 전쟁 발발 76주년이 된 지난 25일 탄도미사일을 발사했다고 공개하면서, 우리 군이 당일 발사 사실을 발표하지 않은 이유가 논란이 되고 있다. 북한의 탄도미사일 발사는 유엔 안전보장이사회의 대북 결의에 위반되기 때문에, 우리 군은 탄도미사일 발사를 포착하는 대로 이를 언론에 공개해 왔다. 합참은 발표가 없었던 이유를 묻는 취지의 본지 질의에 “포착한 발사체들의 세부 제원을 정밀 분석 중”이라고만 답했다. 군이 북한의 탄도미사일 발사를 탐지하지 못했어도 문제고, 다른 이유 때문에 발표하지 않았어도 문제란 지적이 나온다.)

item.title: Drone Command to Be Abolished, Drone Headquarters Established (드론사 사라지고 드론본부 생긴다)
item.description:
Drone Command to Be Abolished, Drone Headquarters Established (드론사 사라지고 드론본부 생긴다)

The Ministry of National Defense announced on the 26th that it will reorganize the Drone Operations Command (Drone Command), which had overseen military drone operations, into a National Defense Drone Headquarters focused on drone policy formulation. This means the Drone Command, established in September 2023, will be dissolved after just two years and nine months. The Ministry also stated that it will accelerate the deployment of the Korean long-range loitering munition 'K-LUCAS' to before 2030 to enhance drone capabilities. (국방부가 드론 관련 군 작전을 총괄했던 드론작전사령부(드론사)를 드론 정책 수립에 집중하는 국방드론본부로 개편하겠다고 26일 밝혔다. 이로써 2023년 9월 창설된 드론사는 2년 9개월 만에 없어지게 됐다. 국방부는 드론 역량 강화를 위해 한국형 장거리 자폭 무인기 ‘K-LUCAS’의 실전 배치도 2030년 이전으로 앞당기겠다고 밝혔다.)

Minister of National Defense Ahn Kyu-baek announced the 'National Defense Drone and Counter-Drone Development Policy' containing these measures at the Ministry of National Defense building in Seoul on the 26th. Currently, drone operational functions across all branches of the military are integrated under the Drone Command, while functions such as policy formulation and drone equipment procurement are dispersed across the Ministry's Policy Office and Logistics Management Bureau. Going forward, drone operational functions will be transferred to each branch—Army, Navy, Air Force, and Marine Corps—while policy and support functions will be consolidated under the newly established National Defense Drone Headquarters. (안규백 국방부 장관은 26일 서울 국방부 청사에서 이런 내용을 담은 ‘국방 드론·대드론 발전 정책’을 발표했다. 현재 전 군의 드론 작전 기능은 드론사에 통합돼 있고, 정책 수립이나 드론 장비 조달 등 기능은 국방부 정책실이나 군수관리국 등에 분산돼 있다. 그런데 앞으로 드론 작전 기능은 육·해·공군 및 해병대 등 각 군에 넘기고, 정책과 지원 기능은 신설되는 국방드론본부로 통합하겠다는 것이다.)

The Ministry explained that the reason for reorganizing the Drone Command is to "develop drone operational concepts and tactics suited to the characteristics and missions of each branch." The Drone Command was established in response to controversy sparked in December 2022, when five North Korean drones violated South Korean airspace and even penetrated the airspace above the Yongsan Presidential Office in Seoul. However, after the December 3 martial law incident, it was revealed that a previous administration had allegedly sent drones into Pyongyang to create a pretext for martial law, leading to investigations by a special counsel into the commander and others, which prompted calls for the command's abolition, particularly from conservative circles. (국방부는 드론사 개편 이유에 대해 “각 군의 특성과 임무에 적합한 드론 운용 개념과 전술을 발전”시키기 위해서라고 했다. 드론사는 2022년 12월 북한 무인기 5대가 우리 영공을 침범하고 서울 용산 대통령실 상공까지 침투한 사실이 알려져 논란이 되자 그에 대한 대응책으로 창설됐다. 그러나 12·3 비상계엄 이후, 전임 정부가 계엄 명분을 만들기 위해 평양에 무인기를 침투시켰다고 알려져 사령관 등이 특검 수사를 받으면서 여권을 중심으로 폐지 여론이 일었다.)

The newly established National Defense Drone Headquarters under the Ministry of National Defense will be led by a Major General. The military also announced the early deployment of the 'K-LUCAS,' a Korean long-range loitering munition similar to the U.S. LUCAS drone, which demonstrated its combat capability in operations against Iran. The initial projection for operational deployment was the mid-2030s, but this has been moved up to before 2030. (국방부 산하에 신설되는 국방드론본부장은 소장급이 맡을 예정이다. 군은 미국이 이란전에 투입해 실전 능력을 확인한 자폭 무인기 루카스(LUCAS)와 비슷한 한국형 장거리 자폭 무인기 ’K-LUCAS’도 조기 배치하겠다고 밝혔다. 당초 2030년대 중반으로 전망된 전력화 시기를 2030년 이전으로 앞당긴다는 것이다.)

The military also stated on the same day that it will secure over 20,000 low-cost expendable drones, including short-range reconnaissance drones and small loitering munitions, by 2030, and will work to acquire next-generation drone capabilities such as AI-equipped swarming drones. To foster a concept where all soldiers use drones like personal weapons—creating '500,000 drone warriors'—the military plans to introduce over 60,000 domestically produced training commercial drones. (군은 또 근거리 정찰 드론, 소형 자폭 드론 등 저가형 소모성 드론을 2030년까지 2만대 이상 확보하고, 인공지능(AI) 기술을 적용한 군집 드론 등 차세대 드론 전력 확보에도 노력하겠다고 이날 밝혔다. 모든 장병이 드론을 개인화기처럼 활용하는 개념인 ‘50만 드론 전사’ 양성을 위해 국산 교육용 상용 드론도 6만여 대 도입할 계획이다.)

item.title: Unilaterally Assigning Standing Committees... National Assembly Speaker Notifies People Power Party via Fax (상임위원 일방 배정하고… 국회의장, 국힘에 팩스 통보)
item.description:
Unilaterally Assigning Standing Committees... National Assembly Speaker Notifies People Power Party via Fax (상임위원 일방 배정하고… 국회의장, 국힘에 팩스 통보)

National Assembly Speaker Woo Won-shik on the 26th notified the People Power Party (PPP) via fax of a plan to form standing committees without consulting the party. He also stated that any objections should be submitted by the 29th. With negotiations between the ruling and opposition parties over the composition of the National Assembly, including the chairmanship of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, at a standstill, he pressured them by indicating he would finalize the composition through his authority. The PPP protested, calling it "a dictatorship that ignores the minority party." Speaker Woo is a former member of the Democratic Party of Korea (DPK) and is currently an independent since being elected as Speaker. <<> Jang Hyun-joo, Senior Secretary for Public Affairs and Communication at the National Assembly Speaker's Office, held a briefing at the National Assembly on this day and stated, "Since the PPP's list did not come in by noon on the 26th, we sent an official document containing the appointment of PPP lawmakers as committee members in accordance with the National Assembly Act." Speaker Woo had initially set the 24th as the deadline for submitting the standing committee list, and when the PPP did not comply, he proposed noon on the 26th as a second deadline. However, as negotiations on the formation of the Assembly remained deadlocked until that day, he notified the PPP of an allocation plan that placed PPP lawmakers on each standing committee. <<> According to the National Assembly Act, standing committee members are appointed by the Speaker at the request of the floor leaders of negotiating groups. It stipulates that if no request is made three days before the end of the term for standing committee members in the first half of the Assembly, the Speaker may appoint them. The term for standing committee members in the first half has already ended as of the end of May. However, in past Assemblies, negotiations between the ruling and opposition parties were prioritized, and delays in forming committees were not uncommon. <<> Chung Jin-suk, floor leader of the PPP, held an emergency press conference and stated, "They set arbitrary deadlines, pressured us to submit a list, and because we didn't give in to that pressure, they unilaterally drew up a list and sent it by fax. This is nothing short of dictatorship." Floor leader Chung added, "Is this the National Assembly? Can the Speaker of the Republic of Korea's National Assembly act this way?" <<> The floor leaders and senior deputy floor leaders for legislative affairs of the ruling and opposition parties met at the National Assembly this afternoon, but failed to narrow their differences over the chairmanship of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, leading to the collapse of negotiations within 20 minutes. The PPP argued that the opposition party has often held the chair of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, and that it is necessary to check the unilateral legislation of the majority party. In contrast, the DPK is seeking to retain the chair of the committee to handle revisions to the Criminal Procedure Act related to the abolition of supplementary investigative powers and the 'Prosecution's Manipulated Indictment Special Counsel Act.' The DPK is also known to hold the position that it should take over the chairmanship of the Strategy and Finance Committee and the Political Affairs Committee, which the PPP chaired in the first half of the 22nd National Assembly. <<> Han Byeong-do, Acting Leader and Floor Leader of the DPK, met with reporters after demanding the Speaker convene a plenary session this afternoon and said, "Starting from the 29th, all lawmakers will go on emergency standby, and we will not let this (the Assembly formation agenda) exceed this month under any circumstances; we will process it without fail." In political circles, there are suggestions that, similar to the first half of the 21st National Assembly in 2020 under the Moon Jae-in administration, the National Assembly Speaker (then Speaker Park Byeong-seok) might allocate standing committees by authority, and the DPK could monopolize all standing committee chairmanships. As an extreme confrontation between the ruling and opposition parties is anticipated, there are voices even within the ruling party expressing concerns about a backlash from a "monopoly on standing committees." (조정식 국회의장이 26일 국민의힘과 상의하지 않은 국회 상임위원회 구성안을 국민의힘에 팩스로 통보했다. 그러면서 이견이 있으면 29일까지 제출하라고 했다. 법제사법위원장 자리 등을 놓고 여야 원구성 협상이 공전하자 직권으로 원구성을 마무리하겠다며 압박한 것이다. 국민의힘은 “소수당을 무시한 독재”라며 반발했다. 조 의장은 더불어민주당 출신으로, 국회의장으로 선출되면서 현재는 무소속이다.)

item.title: Joint Response to North Korean Cyber Threats… S. Korea, US, Japan Hold Working-Level Meeting in Washington (北사이버 위협에 공동 대응…한미일 외교당국 美서 실무회의)
item.description:
Joint Response to North Korean Cyber Threats… S. Korea, US, Japan Hold Working-Level Meeting in Washington (北사이버 위협에 공동 대응…한미일 외교당국 美서 실무회의)

A working-level group meeting of diplomatic authorities from South Korea, the United States, and Japan was held in Washington D.C. on the 25th and 26th to respond to North Korea's cyber threats, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced on the 27th. (북한의 사이버 위협에 대응하기 위한 한·미·일 외교당국 간 실무그룹 회의가 25~26일 미국 워싱턴DC에서 개최됐다고 외교부가 27일 밝혔다.)

According to the ministry, the meeting was attended by chief representatives including Baek Yong-jin, Director-General of the Korean Peninsula Policy Bureau at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs; David Wilezol, Deputy Assistant Secretary of State for Japan and Korea in the U.S. State Department's Bureau of East Asian and Pacific Affairs; and Fumito Miyake, Japan's Ambassador for Cyber Policy at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. (외교부에 따르면 이번 회의엔 백용진 외교부 한반도정책국장, 데이비드 와일레졸 미국 국무부 동아태국 한일 담당 부차관보, 미야케 후미토 일본 외무성 사이버정책대사 등이 수석대표로 참여했다.)

Additionally, about 80 officials from the diplomatic authorities and relevant agencies of the three countries, handling North Korea's nuclear issues and cyber affairs, participated in the meeting. (또 한·미·일 3국 외교당국과 관계부처의 북핵 문제 및 사이버 분야 담당자 80여명이 참석했다.)

South Korea, the U.S., and Japan shared assessments of trends in North Korea's illegal cyber activities, including the theft and laundering of virtual assets and the activities of its IT personnel, and discussed effective response measures through cooperation. (한·미·일은 북한의 가상자산 탈취 및 세탁, IT 인력 활동 등 불법 사이버 활동 동향에 대한 평가를 공유하고 공조를 통한 효과적인 대응 방안을 논의했다.)

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs stated, "The three countries plan to continue related discussions while implementing the cooperative matters agreed upon at this meeting." (외교부는 “3국은 이번 회의에서 협의한 협력 사안을 이행해나가면서 관련 논의를 지속해나갈 예정”이라고 밝혔다.)

item.title: [Political Inside] Spouses of Lawmakers at Cheong Wa Dae Luncheon: Subtle Tensions? The Atmosphere Was Peculiar ([정치 인사이드] 의원 배우자 靑 오찬서 명청 신경전? 분위기 묘했다)
item.description:
[Political Inside] Spouses of Lawmakers at Cheong Wa Dae Luncheon: Subtle Tensions? The Atmosphere Was Peculiar ([정치 인사이드] 의원 배우자 靑 오찬서 명청 신경전? 분위기 묘했다)

President Lee Jae-myung and First Lady Kim Hye-kyung hosted a luncheon for spouses of Democratic Party lawmakers at the Cheong Wa Dae State Guest House on the 22nd. This was the first time the presidential office held an event exclusively for ruling party spouses since President Lee took office. The meal, which lasted nearly two hours, was reportedly warm and friendly overall. However, some attendees mentioned the June 3 local election results and internal party conflicts ahead of the August 17 national convention, leading to talk of subtle jockeying for position. <<> About 110 spouses of ruling party lawmakers attended the luncheon. Among the 161 Democratic Party lawmakers, most were present except for those who were unmarried or whose spouses had scheduling conflicts. It was reported that at the head table where President Lee and his wife sat were the wife of Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and the wife of then-Democratic Party leader Chung Cheong-rae. Other tables were arranged based on the lawmakers' seniority, and many husbands of female lawmakers also attended. <<> The event proceeded by encouraging attendees to speak in turn. During the nearly two-hour luncheon, over 50 people spoke. The first spouse to take the microphone was reportedly the wife of lawmaker Song Young-gil, who returned to the National Assembly via a June by-election. Song is known to be considering a run for party leadership in the August national convention. <<> The wives of another party leadership contender, Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, and former leader Chung Cheong-rae were seated at the head table but reportedly were not given a chance to speak until late in the event. First Lady Kim Hye-kyung reportedly said, "Shouldn't the wives of the Prime Minister and Representative Chung also say a few words?" The two then reportedly made remarks expressing hopes for party unity and progress. <<> In the latter part of the event, some spouses of multi-term lawmakers reportedly voiced concerns about the June local election results and the Democratic Party. According to multiple attendees, one spouse of a multi-term lawmaker said, "The government has only been in office for a short time, and the party is already dividing like this—is that right?" Other spouses reportedly shared their own experiences with the election atmosphere, including regret over the loss in the Seoul mayoral election. At the time, within and outside the Democratic Party, there was tension between the pro-Lee faction, which raised questions about the responsibility of then-leader Chung Cheong-rae for the June local election results, and the pro-Chung faction, which deemed such criticism unfair. <<> In response, a spouse of a pro-Chung lawmaker defended Chung, saying, "We don't need to view the election results too negatively." Among attendees, it was said that remarks like "Couples mirror each other's political messages" and "It's not for nothing that they're said to have a great relationship" were exchanged. One attendee commented, "It wasn't that the atmosphere was hostile, but rather that differing opinions naturally emerged." <<> President Lee reportedly joined the event late and did not hear all the spouses' remarks. He is known to have said that "the party should not divide but move toward unity." First Lady Kim talked about South Korea's standing as felt during her recent European tour and her interest in the globalization of Korean cuisine. After the luncheon ended, spouses reportedly formed a long line to take commemorative photos with First Lady Kim. <<> Regarding the spouses' mention of political issues at the Cheong Wa Dae luncheon, a ruling party official said, "It wasn't the first time they met, so there's an atmosphere of speaking freely." The Democratic Party operates a spouses' group headed by the spouse of the floor leader, and they also participate in volunteer activities together. However, with tensions rising between the pro-Lee and pro-Chung factions ahead of the national convention, some attendees assessed that "a considerable amount of jockeying took place throughout the event." Another attendee reportedly told her lawmaker husband, "Even at the luncheon, you could smell the national convention." (이재명 대통령과 김혜경 여사가 지난 22일 청와대 영빈관에서 더불어민주당 의원 배우자와 오찬 행사를 했다. 청와대가 여당 배우자만 불러 행사를 연 것은 이 대통령 취임 후 처음이다. 2시간 가까이 진행된 식사 분위기는 전반적으로 화기애애했다고 한다. 하지만 일부 참석자는 6·3 지방선거 결과, 8·17 전당대회를 앞둔 당내 갈등을 언급해 미묘한 신경전을 벌였다는 말이 나왔다.)

item.title: Hong Ik-pyo: "Meeting Between President Lee and Former President Moon Pushed Forward Since Immediately After Inauguration… Will Listen to His Insights" (홍익표 “李대통령·文 회동, 취임 직후부터 추진…고견 들을 것”)
item.description:
Hong Ik-pyo: "Meeting Between President Lee and Former President Moon Pushed Forward Since Immediately After Inauguration… Will Listen to His Insights" (홍익표 “李대통령·文 회동, 취임 직후부터 추진…고견 들을 것”)

Hong Ik-pyo, Senior Presidential Secretary for Political Affairs, stated on the 27th regarding President Lee Jae-myung's luncheon with former President Moon Jae-in on the 1st of next month, "The meeting with former President Moon has been pursued since immediately after the inauguration." (홍익표 청와대 정무수석은 이재명 대통령이 다음 달 1일 문재인 전 대통령과 오찬을 하는 것과 관련해 “문 전 대통령과의 회동은 취임 직후부터 추진해 왔다”고 27일 말했다.)

Senior Secretary Hong made this remark in a post on Facebook that day, adding, "However, it could not be arranged amid the hectic schedule of state affairs aimed at normalizing South Korea." (홍 수석은 이날 페이스북에 올린 글에서 이렇게 밝히며 “다만 대한민국 정상화를 위한 숨 가쁜 국정 일정 속에서 그동안 성사되지 못한 것”이라고 했다.)

He continued, "We have been continuously coordinating schedules, and fortunately, the schedules of both individuals aligned on July 1st, allowing the luncheon to take place." (그러면서 “지속적으로 일정을 조율해 왔고, 마침 7월 1일 두 분의 일정이 맞아 오찬을 함께하게 됐다”고 했다.)

Hong said, "The achievements of the past year were possible because of the foundation laid by the Kim Dae-jung, Roh Moo-hyun, and Moon Jae-in administrations," adding, "Now is the time to create changes that the public can feel in their daily lives based on those achievements." (홍 수석은 “지난 1년의 성과는 김대중·노무현·문재인 정부가 다져온 토대가 있었기에 가능했다”며 “이제는 그 성과를 바탕으로 국민께서 일상에서 체감할 수 있는 변화를 만들어야 할 시점”이라고 했다.)

He further stated, "I expect the meeting with former President Moon to be a meaningful occasion for reviving people's livelihoods, uniting the nation, and ensuring the success of the people's sovereignty government, by hearing insights from a former president and exchanging views openly on overall state affairs." (이어 “문 전 대통령과 회동은 민생 회복과 국민 통합, 그리고 국민주권정부의 성공을 위해 전직 대통령으로부터 고견을 듣고 국정 전반에 대해 허심탄회하게 의견을 나누는 뜻깊은 자리가 될 것으로 기대한다”고 했다.)

Earlier, on the 25th, the presidential office announced that President Lee had invited former President Moon to Cheong Wa Dae for a luncheon on the 1st of next month. This announcement came one day after former Democratic Party leader Chung Cheong-rae met with former President Moon on the 24th, shortly after declaring his resignation as party leader. (앞서 청와대는 이 대통령이 문 전 대통령을 청와대로 초청해 다음 달 1일 오찬을 함께할 계획이라고 지난 25일 발표했다. 청와대의 이 발표는 정청래 전 더불어민주당 대표가 24일 당대표 사퇴를 선언한 직후 문 전 대통령을 만난 지 하루 만에 나왔다.)

In response, some in political circles have speculated, "Ahead of the Democratic Party's national convention, could President Lee be supporting Prime Minister Kim Min-seok as a candidate for party leadership while also keeping former leader Chung in check?" Senior Secretary Hong's remarks today are interpreted as a response to such perspectives. (이를 두고 정치권에서는 “민주당 전당대회를 앞두고, 이 대통령이 당권 주자로 김민석 국무총리를 지원하고 정 전 대표를 견제하는 측면도 있지 않겠느냐”는 말이 나왔다. 홍 수석의 이날 언급은 이런 시각 등을 의식한 것이라는 해석이 나온다.)

item.title: People Power Party: "President Lee's Hint at 'GPU Supplementary Budget' Is Stoking Fires for 'Cash Handouts'" (국힘 “李대통령 ‘GPU 추경’ 시사는 ‘현금살포’ 군불 때기”)
item.description:
People Power Party: "President Lee's Hint at 'GPU Supplementary Budget' Is Stoking Fires for 'Cash Handouts'" (국힘 “李대통령 ‘GPU 추경’ 시사는 ‘현금살포’ 군불 때기”)

The People Power Party criticized on the 27th President Lee Jae-myung's remark that "We may or may not implement a supplementary budget, but graphics processing units (GPUs) will increasingly be needed on a larger scale," stating, "The Lee Jae-myung administration is trying to consume even AI as another justification for a supplementary budget." <<> Senior Spokesperson Park Seong-hoon said in a commentary that day, "President Lee has hinted at compiling a second supplementary budget and has started stoking fires for a 'cash handout supplementary budget' using AI." <<> He added, "If temporary excess tax revenue is anticipated, it's common sense to use it to reduce national debt and restore fiscal soundness. But President Lee is only fixated on the idea of splurging finances for political gain. Is the national treasury President Lee's pocket money?" <<> He further stated, "As approval ratings plummet, this is a cheap scheme to try to weather a political crisis by scattering taxpayers' money," and "a despicable trick to buy public sentiment with 'money-throwing.'" <<> He then emphasized, "Artificial intelligence (AI) competitiveness is built through long-term investment and regulatory innovation, not through a one-off supplementary budget." (국민의힘은 27일 이재명 대통령이 “우리가 추가경정예산(추경)을 하게 될지 모르겠으나 그래픽처리장치(GPU)는 점점 더 대규모로 필요할 것”이라고 언급한 것과 관련, “이재명 정권은 AI마저 또 하나의 추경 명분으로 소비하려 하고 있다”고 비판했다.)

item.title: About 10 Chinese and Russian Military Aircraft Enter KADIZ… Air Force Fighters Scrambled in Response (중·러 군용기 10여대 KADIZ 진입…공군 전투기 출격 대응)
item.description:
About 10 Chinese and Russian Military Aircraft Enter KADIZ… Air Force Fighters Scrambled in Response (중·러 군용기 10여대 KADIZ 진입…공군 전투기 출격 대응)

Around 10 Chinese and Russian military aircraft entered the Korea Air Defense Identification Zone (KADIZ) on the 27th, prompting a military response. (중국과 러시아 군용기 10여 대가 27일 한국 방공식별구역(KADIZ·카디즈)에 진입해 군이 대응했다.)

According to the Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS), around 10 Chinese and Russian military aircraft sequentially entered and then exited the KADIZ over the East Sea and South Sea on the morning of that day, with no airspace violations occurring during the process. (합동참모본부(합참)에 따르면 이날 오전 중국과 러시아 군용기 10여 대가 동해 및 남해 KADIZ에 순차적으로 진입 후 이탈했으며 이 과정에서 영공 침범은 없었다.)

The military stated, “We identified and tracked the Chinese and Russian military aircraft before they entered the KADIZ, and deployed Air Force fighters to conduct tactical measures in preparation for potential contingencies.” (군은 “중국과 러시아 군용기가 KADIZ에 진입하기 이전부터 이를 식별해 추적했고, 공군 전투기를 투입해 우발 상황에 대비한 전술조치 등을 실시했다”고 밝혔다.)

The Chinese and Russian military aircraft that entered the KADIZ are reported to be bombers and fighters, believed to be part of the ongoing joint air training between China and Russia. (KADIZ에 진입한 중국과 러시아 군용기는 폭격기와 전투기로, 현재 진행 중인 중·러 연합공중훈련 참가 전력인 것으로 전해졌다.)

This marks the first time Chinese and Russian military aircraft have entered the KADIZ since December of last year. At that time, nine Chinese and Russian military aircraft participating in joint training also entered and then exited the KADIZ over the East Sea and South Sea. (중국과 러시아 군용기가 KADIZ에 진입한 것은 지난해 12월 이후 처음이다. 당시에도 연합훈련 참가 전력인 중·러 군용기 9대가 동해 및 남해 KADIZ에 진입했다가 이탈했다.)

An air defense identification zone is an arbitrary line set to quickly identify and respond to military aircraft approaching a country's airspace, and it is a different concept from airspace, which is a matter of individual national sovereignty. (방공식별구역은 자국 영공으로 접근하는 군용 항공기를 조기에 식별해 대응하기 위해 설정하는 임의의 선으로, 개별 국가의 주권 사항인 영공과는 다른 개념이다.)

However, it is international practice for military aircraft entering another country’s air defense identification zone to submit a flight plan in advance and notify the country of their position upon entry. (다만 다른 나라 방공식별구역 안에 진입하는 군용 항공기는 해당 국가에 미리 비행계획을 제출하고 진입 시 위치 등을 통보하는 것이 국제적 관행이다.)

item.title: "A Pig Sees a Pig"... Who Was President Lee Targeting? (“돼지 눈엔 돼지 보이는 법”... 李대통령 누구를 겨냥했나)
item.description:
"A Pig Sees a Pig"... Who Was President Lee Targeting? (“돼지 눈엔 돼지 보이는 법”... 李대통령 누구를 겨냥했나)

President Lee Jae-myung posted on his X (formerly Twitter) account on the 27th, saying, "As the saying goes, 'A Buddha sees a Buddha, and a pig sees a pig.'" (이재명 대통령은 27일 자신의 X(옛 트위터)에 글을 올려 “부처 눈에는 부처가 보이고 돼지 눈에는 돼지가 보이는 법”이라고 말했다.)

He added, "People often think that others will act and think the way they themselves do." (이어 “내가 생각하고 행동하는 것처럼 타인도 그럴 것이라고 생각하는 경우가 많다”고 했다.)

The specific intent behind the president's use of this expression was not clearly revealed in the post. Various interpretations are emerging within political circles. (이 대통령이 어떤 뜻으로 이런 표현을 썼는지는 글에서 구체적으로 드러나지 않았다. 정치권에선 다양한 해석이 나오고 있다.)

Some speculate that it may be a reaction to the opposition's opposition to the government's review of creating a semiconductor cluster in the Honam region, which they dismissed as a "tactical decision." This is because President Lee posted about "no concerns over industrial water shortages in the Honam region" just five minutes before the aforementioned post. (일각에선 야권이 정부의 호남권 반도체 클러스터 조성 검토에 대해 “정략적 결정”이라는 등 이유로 반발하는 데 대한 반응 아니냐는 추측이 나온다. 이 대통령이 해당 글을 올리기 5분 전 ‘호남 지역에 산업용수 부족 우려는 없다’는 취지의 글을 올렸기 때문이다.)

In a commentary the previous day, the 26th, the People Power Party criticized the government's semiconductor investment in Honam, stating, "President Lee has reduced even Cheong Wa Dae and the national core strategic industry of semiconductors to political fodder for the Democratic Party's leadership race." (국민의힘은 전날인 26일 논평에서 정부의 호남권 반도체 투자와 관련해 “이 대통령이 끝내 청와대는 물론 국가 핵심 전략 산업인 반도체까지 더불어민주당 전당대회의 당권 다툼을 위한 정치적 소모품으로 전락시켰다”고 했다.)

The implication is that Cheong Wa Dae, ahead of the party convention to elect the next party leader, intended to funnel money into Honam—a key "vote bank"—to rally support for candidates aligned with the pro-Lee faction. People Power Party lawmaker Ahn Cheol-soo wrote on Facebook, "Using private companies' capital, with Cheong Wa Dae taking the lead to designate a specific region and demand investment, is a clear abuse of authority." (청와대가 차기 당 대표를 뽑는 전당대회를 앞두고 핵심 ‘표밭’인 호남에 돈을 풀어 친명계 후보에게 표를 몰아주려는 의도 아니냐는 취지다. 안철수 국민의힘 의원은 페이스북에서 “민간 기업의 자본으로, 청와대가 주도하여, 특정 지역을 점찍어 투자를 요구하는 것은 명백한 직권남용”이라고도 했다.)

On the other hand, some interpret the post as targeting former Roh Moo-hyun Foundation Chairman Yoo Si-min's assessment that President Lee's move to expand his support base to centrists and conservatives was "overconfident." (한편으론 유시민 전 노무현재단 이사장이 이 대통령이 중도·보수로 지지층을 넓히려는 움직임에 대해 “자신감이 지나쳤다”고 평가한 것을 겨냥한 것 아니냐는 해석도 나온다.)

In the previous day's episode of the YouTube channel "Kim Eo-joon's Dasvoeida," Yoo cited terms frequently used by President Lee, such as "president for everyone," "embrace," and "unity," saying, "It makes me think the president may have been overly confident." He also commented on the president's administration and the internal dynamics of the Democratic Party, stating, "What the public wanted was an extension (of the democratic camp). But it seems President Lee tried to tear everything down and rebuild, mobilizing demolition crews." (유 전 이사장은 전날 공개된 유튜브 채널 ‘김어준의 다스뵈이다’에서 이 대통령이 자주 쓰는 단어로 ‘모두의 대통령’ ‘포용’ ‘통합’ 등을 들며 “대통령이 자신감이 지나쳤던 것 아닌가 하는 생각도 든다”고 했다. 또 이 대통령의 국정 운영과 민주당 내부 상황을 두고 “대중이 원하는 것은 (민주 진영의) 증축이었다”며 “그런데 이 대통령은 철거 용역 등을 동원해 다 허물고 재건축을 하려고 했던 것 같다”고도 했다.)

A Cheong Wa Dae official said, "The president's post on social media was based on principle," adding, "However, let it be noted that it reflects regret over the spread of baseless speculation and false claims about concentrated corporate investments in the regions." The official also urged, "Please be cautious about excessive interpretations in reporting." <<>> (청와대 관계자는 “이 대통령이 SNS에 게재한 글은 원칙적 내용”이라며 “다만 기업의 지방 집중 투자에 대한 억측과 허위 주장이 유포됨에 대한 안타까움이라는 점을 참고로 알린다”고 했다. 그러면서 “과도한 해석 보도에 유의해 달라”고 했다.)
